summary: Chaldal.com was the only Bangladeshi retailer reliably fetchable in this session (Daraz Bangladesh returned empty JS shells, Shwapno and Khaas Food returned 403 bot-wall errors, and DuckDuckGo HTML search hit a CAPTCHA), so all 11 recorded observations come from Chaldal and cover all 6 categories, including banana flower (kolar mocha) as a genuine, traditional edible-flower entry. Confirmed via direct site search to be absent from Chaldal: fresh arugula, kale, fresh basil (only dried/bottled basil sold), fresh parsley (only dried flakes), zucchini, strawberries, cherry tomatoes, and three of the four microgreen sub-types (only radish microgreen matched; mustard/amaranth/mung-bean/baby-cabbage microgreens exist but are not benchmark items). This session's WebSearch tool quota was exhausted partway through, which limited cross-retailer verification beyond Chaldal.
